Name: (CP) Fix Pierre's Map Tooltip (Vanilla)
Author: CyanFire
Description:
OBSOLETE IN 1.6!


A simple mod to correct Pierre's opening times on the map after the Community Centre is completed so it no longer displays "Closed on Wednesday", just something that bugged me while playing.
All languages are included!

This is intended for vanilla as the times will be incorrect for any mod that alters the opening time.
